flag_semantics.proven_source: PoseSetBoneContainer normalizes the nonzero byte returned from *(bone_container + 0x48) + 0x111 independently of extra-array allocation.

instruction_evidence.meaning: Extra-array source count must be positive and equal to transform count to take the array transfer path.
The other path clears destination extra-array count and releases its allocation when necessary.
After either array path, copies source mode byte to destination context+0x28 independently of whether extra-array storage is empty.
Bone-container counts at +0xb8 and +0xa8 govern allocation/clearing of the 12-byte extra-vector array.
Then independently derives the pose+0x20/context+0x28 Boolean from the container-associated pointer and its +0x111 byte.
Reads component-space flags and 48-byte transform storage; it does not use the extra-array header or the independent mode byte.
Commits normal 48-byte transform values and component-space flags; the extra channel/mode byte is not changed.

unsupported: nonzero extra-array data or capacity despite zero count
